content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-18|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-infrastructure-reality-check-4|Payment Infrastructure]]-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-my-unfiltered-take|payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-3. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after a crypto payment is a robust framework that allows digital creators to sell their products directly to consumers without relying on traditional payment processors. This is vital in regions where payment access is limited or where high fees from platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on sales, cut deeply into profits. By leveraging NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, creators can retain more of their earnings and streamline their operations. This infrastructure not only reduces costs but also gives creators full ownership of their sales process, enabling them to establish a more sustainable business model.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this infrastructure is a combination of free hosting and backend technologies that enable automated delivery. Using platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, paired with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, digital creators can effortlessly manage transactions and product deliveries. When a customer completes a payment via crypto, NOWPayments processes the transaction and triggers a webhook that automatically delivers the purchased ebook. This seamless integration of tools not only eliminates reliance on traditional payment systems but also ensures that creators maintain full control over their digital assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators across regions like Nigeria, Kenya, Venezuela, and others where conventional payment processors impose restrictions. These creators often sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products, yet struggle to collect payments effectively. By adopting this automated delivery system, they can bypass the barriers imposed by platforms like PayPal and Gumroad, ensuring they retain a higher percentage of their earnings. This infrastructure empowers creators to operate independently and sustainably, allowing them to focus on their craft rather than on navigating payment challenges.
Keep more of your earnings by switching from high-fee platforms to NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The automated delivery system comprises several critical components. First, hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide a reliable platform for product listings. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, processing orders and facilitating product delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets serve as databases for tracking orders. Finally, NOWPayments enables crypto payment processing, ensuring instant and low-cost transactions. Together, these tools form a cohesive ecosystem that supports digital creators in delivering their products efficiently and effectively, without the overhead of traditional platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this automated ebook delivery system, start by selecting a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up a backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing. Next, configure your database using Supabase or Google Sheets for order tracking. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto payments, ensuring your system can convert prices in USD at transaction time. Finally, test the entire workflow to ensure seamless delivery of digital products upon payment confirmation. For those looking for comprehensive guidance, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the blueprints and templates necessary for building and scaling your digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automate your product delivery process for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell ebooks by using a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates tools for hosting, order processing, and crypto payment handling, eliminating reliance on PayPal or Stripe.

Yes, by setting up your own automated delivery system using free hosting and NOWPayments, you can effectively sell templates and fonts without dependency on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my ebook sales?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies for your ebook sales, thus catering to diverse buyer preferences.
How do I ensure instant delivery of my digital products?
By integrating Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script with your payment processing system, you can automate the delivery of digital products immediately after payment confirmation.
